terminal.none: no authored success or break state; the pick loop does not resolve

scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.state = 'picking'
v.pins_picked = 0
v.total_pins = 3
v.cursor_pos = 0
v.cursor_dir = 1
v.cursor_speed = 30
v.sweet_spot_start = 20
v.sweet_spot_width = 15
v.display_text = ''
v.status_text = 'Press ENTER in the sweet spot!'
scripts.update:
local v = ctx.v
if v.state ~= 'picking' then return end
local dt = time.dt
v.cursor_pos = v.cursor_pos + (v.cursor_speed * v.cursor_dir * dt)
if v.cursor_pos > 100 then
    v.cursor_pos = 100
    v.cursor_dir = -1
elseif v.cursor_pos < 0 then
    v.cursor_pos = 0
    v.cursor_dir = 1
end
local text = '['
for i = 1, 20 do
    local p_start = (i - 1) * 5
    local p_end = i * 5
    local isSweet = (p_end >= v.sweet_spot_start and p_start <= v.sweet_spot_start + v.sweet_spot_width)
    local isNeedle = (v.cursor_pos >= p_start and v.cursor_pos < p_end)
    if i == 20 and v.cursor_pos >= 100 then isNeedle = true end
    if isNeedle and isSweet then text = text .. '+'
    elseif isNeedle then text = text .. '|'
    elseif isSweet then text = text .. '='
    else text = text .. '-' end
end
text = text .. ']'
v.display_text = text
scripts.pick:
local v = ctx.v
if v.state ~= 'picking' then
    v.state = 'picking'
    v.pins_picked = 0
    v.cursor_speed = 30
    v.sweet_spot_start = 20
    v.status_text = 'Press ENTER in the sweet spot!'
    return
end
if v.cursor_pos >= v.sweet_spot_start and v.cursor_pos <= v.sweet_spot_start + v.sweet_spot_width then
    v.pins_picked = v.pins_picked + 1
    if v.pins_picked >= v.total_pins then
        v.state = 'won'
        v.status_text = 'LOCK PICKED! Press ENTER to replay.'
    else
        v.status_text = 'Pin set!'
        v.cursor_speed = v.cursor_speed + 15
        v.sweet_spot_start = math.random(10, 70)
    end
else
    v.state = 'failed'
    v.status_text = 'FAILED! Pick broke. Press ENTER to retry.'
end
